subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: captures speech from all directions while rejecting background noise.

subsystems.name: On-device processing
subsystems.role: detects wake words, compresses audio and manages power.

subsystems.name: Connectivity
subsystems.role: links the pendant to a phone or directly to the internet.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.role: keeps the device running through a day of intermittent use.

subsystems.name: Cloud AI pipeline
subsystems.role: turns speech into summaries, reminders and translations.

subsystems.name: Privacy and security
subsystems.role: protects recordings and gives the user control over when audio is captured.

subsystems.name: Enclosure
subsystems.role: makes the device wearable and discreet.

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustic front end
buildSteps.detail: Choose MEMS microphones and place them in an array to form beams that favour the wearer's voice and suppress ambient noise.

buildSteps.title: Develop always-on firmware
buildSteps.detail: Implement low-power wake-word detection and circular audio buffering on a microcontroller so the device listens without draining the battery.

buildSteps.title: Build the electronics
buildSteps.detail: Lay out and assemble the printed circuit board with the system-on-chip, memory, radios and battery management, then test each unit.

buildSteps.title: Create the cloud pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Stream audio to a speech-to-text service, pass the transcript to a large language model for summarisation and question answering, and store results securely.

buildSteps.title: Write the companion app
buildSteps.detail: Pair over Bluetooth, let the user manage settings, and display transcripts, summaries and reminders.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture and assemble
buildSteps.detail: Injection-mould enclosures, solder components, fit the battery and microphone mesh, and seal the unit.

buildSteps.title: Test and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Measure microphone sensitivity, battery life and wireless range in an anechoic chamber and in real environments, then update firmware.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Ship the product, gather usage data with consent, and push over-the-air updates to improve accuracy and add features.
